value.behaviour: Adds changeArrowheadSize to the ActionName union.

New registered action changeArrowheadSize sets arrowheadSize on selected arrows/lines and currentItemArrowheadSize, with an S/M/L RadioSelection panel; the compact arrow-properties popover renders it too.
rules: 1. `actionChangeArrowheadSize = register<ArrowheadSize>({ name: "changeArrowheadSize", label: "labels.arrowheadSize", trackEvent: false, perform, PanelComponent })`.

2. perform: `invariant(value, ...)`; elements = `changeProperty(elements, appState, (el) => isLinearElement(el) ? newElementWith(el, { arrowheadSize: value }) : el)`; appState = `{ ...appState, currentItemArrowheadSize: value }`; `captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY`. No elbow re-route (the size does not change points).

3. PanelComponent: `
{t("labels.arrowheadSize")}
group="arrowhead-size" .../>
`, shaped like actionChangeStrokeWidth's panel.

4. Options in order small/medium/large: text `t("labels.arrowheadSize_<preset>")`, icons FontSizeSmallIcon / FontSizeMediumIcon / FontSizeLargeIcon, testIds `arrowheadSize-small` / `arrowheadSize-medium` / `arrowheadSize-large`.

5. value: `getFormValue<ArrowheadSize | null>(elements, app, (element) => isLinearElement(element) ? element.arrowheadSize ?? DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE : appState.currentItemArrowheadSize, (element) => isLinearElement(element), (hasSelection) => hasSelection ? null : appState.currentItemArrowheadSize)`; onChange calls `updateData(value)`.
